inputs.label: ASTRO BOT Rescue Mission dump (PS4, CUSA12392)
inputs.help: A dump of the European PS4 release CUSA12392, version 1.00, from your own console, as a .pkg file.

steps.why: Android creates Android/data/com.astrobotquest.vrhost/files on the first launch.

steps.text: Pair a PS5 DualSense controller in Settings > Bluetooth. Then open Astro VR Host from Library > Unknown Sources and allow the microphone when asked. Hold the DualSense inside the floating outline to calibrate.

notes: The guide also accepts the dump as an unpacked folder; only the .pkg form is modelled. The guide does not say to launch first; the launch is there because the target is in Android/data. Needs Quest 3 or 3S. The release also has a PC VR Windows zip.
